neo4rs native bench — single process, tokio multi-thread runtime, db=finbenchl1
neo4rs 0.8.0, fetch_size 1000, rows materialized as owned (i64, String, f64) tuples.
  workers=1  p50   4.6 ms   p99   5.4 ms   client-util  26%   cpu/call  1.2 ms
  workers=2  p50   5.6 ms   p99   7.5 ms   client-util  49%   cpu/call  1.4 ms
  workers=4  p50   6.1 ms   p99   7.5 ms   client-util 131%   cpu/call  2.1 ms
  workers=8  p50   7.7 ms   p99   9.3 ms   client-util 244%   cpu/call  2.5 ms
Same load as bench_driver_memory.py concurrency stage (2,000-row calls, 25/worker).
At 8 workers: python threads (pure) p50 769 ms / 124 ms cpu-per-call / 1.3 cores;
python 8 processes p50 81 ms / 84 ms / 7.2 cores; neo4rs ONE process p50 7.7 ms / 2.5 ms.
The ceiling was the runtime; the cost was the representation.
